mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.ticket (code, type, status, account_id, branch_id, created_by, from_status, to_status, reason, submit_count, process_instance_id, new_customer) VALUES (#{code}, #{type}, #{status}, #{accountId}, #{branchId}, #{createdBy}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{reason}, #{submitCount}, #{processInstanceId}, #{newCustomer})

INSERT INTO app.attachment (ticket_id, original_name, storage_key, content_type, size_bytes, uploaded_by, uploaded_at) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{originalName}, #{storageKey}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{uploadedBy}, now())
INSERT INTO app.ticket_history (ticket_id, action, from_status, to_status, actor_id, note) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{actorId}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.account_number, a.status, a.customer_id, c.full_name AS customer_name, c.cccd AS customer_cccd, t.name AS account_type_name, b.name AS branch_name, open_ticket.code AS open_ticket_code, open_ticket.status AS open_ticket_status FROM app.account a JOIN app.customer c ON c.id = a.customer_id JOIN app.account_type t ON t.id = a.account_type_id JOIN app.branch b ON b.id = a.branch_id LEFT JOIN app.ticket open_ticket ON open_ticket.account_id = a.id AND open_ticket.status IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL', 'REJECTED') WHERE a.account_number = #{accountNumber}

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, (SELECT t.code FROM app.ticket t JOIN app.account a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE a.customer_id = c.id AND t.type = 'MO_TAI_KHOAN' AND t.new_customer AND t.status IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL', 'REJECTED') LIMIT 1) AS pending_ticket_code, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.account a WHERE a.customer_id = c.id AND (a.status <> 'CLOSED' OR a.opened_at IS NOT NULL)) AS reusable FROM app.customer c
AND c.cccd = #{cccd} AND c.id = #{customerId}

SELECT tk.id, tk.code, tk.type, tk.status, tk.account_id, a.account_number, a.customer_id, c.full_name AS customer_name, c.cccd AS customer_cccd, t.name AS account_type_name, tk.from_status, tk.to_status, tk.new_customer, creator.full_name AS created_by_name, b.name AS branch_name, reviewer.full_name AS reviewed_by_name, tk.reason, tk.reject_reason, tk.submit_count, tk.created_at, tk.last_submitted_at FROM app.ticket tk JOIN app.employee creator ON creator.id = tk.created_by JOIN app.branch b ON b.id = tk.branch_id LEFT JOIN app.employee reviewer ON reviewer.id = tk.reviewed_by LEFT JOIN app.account a ON a.id = tk.account_id LEFT JOIN app.customer c ON c.id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN app.account_type t ON t.id = a.account_type_id WHERE tk.id = #{id}
SELECT id, original_name, storage_key, content_type, size_bytes FROM app.attachment WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND removed_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT id, original_name, storage_key, content_type, size_bytes FROM app.attachment WHERE id = #{attachmentId} AND ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND removed_at IS NULL

SELECT h.action, h.from_status, h.to_status, e.full_name AS actor_name, h.note, h.created_at FROM app.ticket_history h LEFT JOIN app.employee e ON e.id = h.actor_id WHERE h.ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC
